typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CRITERION_NAME as string,
		CRITERION_VALUE as string,
		Load_Date as timestamp,
		IS_IN_B as integer,
		TRADE_FILTER_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		CRITERION_NAME as string,
		CRITERION_VALUE as string,
		Load_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		IS_IN_B as integer,
		TRADE_FILTER_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CRITERION_NAME,
		CRITERION_VALUE,
		Load_date = Load_Date,
		IS_IN_B,
		TRADE_FILTER_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
